name: AI D1 - Registry resolve
description: Companies House resolve for account_intel.accounts: confidence-scored name match, profile, PSC; saves via intel_save_registry; disqualifies dissolved.

parameters.content:
## D1 - Registry resolve (Companies House)
Loads accounts with no registry row → CH search → confidence-scored match (1.0 exact, 0.9 domain/previous name, 0.85 prefix, 0.7 tokens = review) → profile + PSC for matches → intel_save_registry.

No-match is saved too, so re-running only touches new accounts. Dissolved / liquidation / administration are disqualified in the RPC. Each CH node throttled to 2 req/s (limit 600 per 5 min).

Irish (.ie) rows get a CH search too; CRO lookup is a later addition.

parameters.jsCode:
const m = $json;
return { json: { p_account_id: m.account_id, p_registry: m.registry_hint || 'CH', p_company_number: null, p_registered_name: null, p_status: null, p_incorporated_on: null, p_sic_codes: null, p_accounts_type: null, p_foreign_psc: null, p_officer_countries: null, p_match_confidence: 0, p_matched_by: 'none', p_raw: { candidates: m.candidates || [] } } };
